description: Get the facts on file for one business in the VoiceAssistants directory: what it is, where, phone, hours, and — for a premium listing — services with supplied prices, service area, credentials and live availability. Every fact comes from the business; `source` and `last_verified` say where and when. Pass the `id` from find_businesses. Read `spoken` aloud.

id.description: The business id from find_businesses, for example "seaside-plumbing-stuart-fl".

name: get_business
title: Get a business's facts
